title: Flock Audit Logs Dunwoody April - June 2024

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Georgia Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Copies of all audit logs, search logs, or usage reports related to your agency's use of Flock "ALPR" systems for the period March 1, 2024 through June 31, 2024. Specifically I would like the "Organization Audit" logs available in the Flock software's "Insights" section, showing records of license plate searches performed by agency personnel, timestamps of searches, user identification information (names, badge numbers, or user IDs), and any associated case numbers or investigation references.

Please provide records in their original electronic format (CSV, Excel, or similar).

To the extent any portion of these records is claimed exempt under the Open Records Act, I request that the exemption be applied at the field or column level rather than by withholding entire logs, consistent with the segregability requirement of O.C.G.A. § 50-18-71(b)(1)(A). If a specific field (such as the free-text search justification field) is withheld, please identify which field and the specific statutory basis for withholding it.

Please proceed with column level redactions as discussion on previous requests.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jason Hunyar

title: Donald W. Wyatt Detention Facillity Annual Reports from 2021 - 2025

communications.subject: Rhode Island Access to Public Records Act Request: Donald W. Wyatt Detention Facillity Annual Reports from 2021 - 2025
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Rhode Island Access to Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Annual reports about the operations and finances of the Donald W. Wyatt Detention Facility, from the years 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025.

I previously made a request for all Wyatt Detention Facility annual reports dating back to 1993. But the reports I was sent in response ended at the year 2020. 

According to RI Gen L § 45-54-22. (2025):

"Within one hundred twenty (120) days from the close of its fiscal year, the corporation shall make an annual report to the chief executive officer and legislative body of the municipality of its activities for the preceding fiscal year. Each report shall present a complete operating and financial statement covering its operations during the year. The corporation shall cause an annual audit of the books, records, and accounts of the corporation to be made and the costs shall be treated as a part of the cost of operation."

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Philip Eil
